rules.description: A part is ordered only from suppliers whose status for that part on the approved-vendor list is approved.
Each order line (one week, part and supplier) is at least the supplier's minimum order quantity.
Purchases in each month (by the Monday of the order week) stay within that month's budget.
Seoul PCB Tech (S05) is on quality hold; its goods due to arrive in weeks W1 to W5 are rejected.
Orders placed in one month with a supplier for a part on allocation stay within that supplier's monthly allocation.
Every critical part in use is ordered from at least two suppliers, and no supplier gets more than 80% of its ordered quantity.
